title: Prana canonical ingredient
description: One canonical ingredient with its aliases, stored at data/ingredients/<id>.json. This is what turns palmolein oil, palm olein and refined palm oil on three different packets into one flag the app can reason about.

aliases.description: Label wordings that mean this ingredient. Matching is case and whitespace insensitive, so aliases are stored in their natural form. Add an alias when you see it on a real packet, not speculatively.

flags.description: Attributes the app can surface. The may_be_ flags exist because a label often does not say enough to be certain. Indian labels routinely declare edible vegetable oil without naming the oil, and it frequently is palm; recording that as may_be_palm_derived is the honest answer, where claiming either presence or absence would not be. Recording the uncertainty is the point.

explanation.description: Plain English, factual, no health verdict. Explain what it is and why it is on the label, not whether it is good for you.

country_notes.description: Where labelling convention or regulation differs by country.
